title: Your order
intro: Review your purchase, payment network and total before sending Bitcoin.

title: Scan to pay
intro: Scan this QR code with a wallet on the network shown in your order summary. It includes the address and exact amount.

title: Pay from another device
intro: You can also copy the amount and Bitcoin address into your wallet. Send the exact amount; your wallet adds the network fee separately.

title: Follow your payment
intro: This page updates automatically when your payment arrives and after network confirmation. If you already sent Bitcoin, do not pay again.
